data.name: Snafubar
data.detailed_description:
Snafubar is a 3v3 online-multiplayer arena combat game where you design your own kit with your choice of powerful spell, weapons, explosives, and building planks to take control of the map and eliminate the enemy team. Destroy terrain with fireballs and grenades, while your teammates launch across the map with pulse bombs and zero-gravity boots! Just make sure not to fall off the world and into the void...

FEATURES

  • Choose from 5+ powerful spells, 20+ items, and equippable gear to customize your fighting experience! Your choices can synergize, leading to emergent gameplay and interactions.

  • Fight to the death on 5 3D voxel-based maps, which can be destroyed by explosives and shovels, all to gain the upper hand against your opponents.

  • Play best-of-five matches, where your constructions and craters from previous rounds affect your strategy in the next!

  • Progress through the ranks to compare with your friends. (COMING SOON!)

  • Unlock spells, items, and gear with XP earned from playing matches. (COMING SOON!)

Wishlist now! Demo coming soon.

data.short_description: Design your kit with powerful spells, weapons, and gear to explode, slice, and overwhelm your opponents in this tactical 3v3 team arena fighter with destructible terrain - which is floating in the void, so don't fall!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500, AMD Radeon R5, NVIDIA GTX 750
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan drivers installed and up-to-date
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD RX 460, or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan drivers installed and up-to-date
